result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M/2M, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M tied to processing Customer data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing risk-of-loss language. However, requiring every policy to remain in place for one year after the term goes beyond the playbook and is particularly unnecessary for workers’ compensation and occurrence-based CGL, so the addition is not strictly minimal. Drafting is otherwise professional, though “Customer Data” should use the defined capitalization.
